pages.quiz:
ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the Library
   B. Where is the library?
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the library

2. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.

3. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.

4. When practising Punctuation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Punctuation.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Punctuation.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Punctuation.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Punctuation.

5. When practising Language Activities at home, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Activities at home.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Language Activities at home.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Language Activities at home.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Language Activities at home.

6. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.

7. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. quickly
   B. run
   C. blue
   D. happiness

8. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only an action
   B. A person, place, thing, or idea
   C. Only a joining word
   D. Only a describing word

9. When practising Guided Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Writing.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Guided Writing.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Guided Writing.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Guided Writing.

10. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goed
   B. goes
   C. going
   D. went

11. When practising Spelling, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Spelling.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Spelling.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Spelling.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Spelling.

12. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.

13. When practising Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Attentive Listening.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Attentive Listening.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening.

14. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. One main idea with supporting sentences
   B. Only one word repeated
   C. No full stops
   D. Many unrelated topics with no link

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive Listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Word Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Connected text and fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Language Activities at home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
